input.brief_narrative: NVIDIA presents a compelling near-term bullish case underpinned by two high-quality signals: CEO insider buying at $892/share — a Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski tier signal carrying 82bps/month historical alpha — and a 12% Q1 2026 revenue beat driven by 220% data center growth. Institutional conviction is strong on both counts. However, retail sentiment on Reddit WSB has inverted sharply, with 73% bearish mentions over 48 hours, suggesting the stock is viewed as priced to perfection by the crowd. The divergence between SEC/Yahoo signals (bullish, high confidence) and Reddit (bearish, low weight) is the primary cross-source tension in this brief. Data quality is partial — LinkedIn hiring trends, Glassdoor reviews, GDELT news, and satellite data were unavailable, leaving operational health unassessed. Overall confidence: 0.73 (partial coverage penalty applied).
cross_source_contradictions: sec (bullish) contradicts reddit (bearish): CEO buying at $892 signals insider conviction while retail WSB sentiment is 73% bearish — potential crowded-long fragility
